title: Milwaukee County Exec David Crowley Launches Bid For Governor
description:
FULL INTERVIEW: Shortly after announcing his gubernatorial run, Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley joined WTMJ's Steve Scaffidi on Point Taken. 

WATCH as they discuss why he's running, what he plans on doing as Governor, working with President Donald Trump, and using Wisconsin's budget surplus.

title: New bill in Congress targets "birth tourism"
description:
A new bill in Congress seeks to revoke birthright citizenship for the children whose parents entered the U.S. illegally, and takes aim at immigrants who travel to the country solely to get citizenship for their children.

Republican Rep. Brandon Gill of Flower Mound filed the bill. He says the legislation would not require a constitutional amendment.

description:
